metadata.description: Back-office agents for dental practices and veterinary clinics. Each reads files the clinic already exports (practice-management reports, 835 remittances, pet-insurance and processor exports), masks patient, pet and client names before results reach the model, writes worklists locally and waits for one named person before anything is sent, filed, refunded or paid.

plugins.name: fairclinic-boarding-grooming
plugins.description: Fairclinic Boarding and Grooming: boarding, daycare and grooming reservations against invoice lines: stays with no invoice, fewer nights or days invoiced than stayed, and booked add-ons not invoiced, valued at your list prices. It never changes an invoice or charges a client. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-card-deposits
plugins.description: Fairclinic Card Deposits: card processor batches against bank deposits and the practice system's card totals: batches that never arrived, deposits at a different amount, chargebacks, days where the practice system differs, high fees, and card deposits that match no batch. It never responds to disputes, refunds or posts anything.

plugins.name: fairclinic-claims-aging
plugins.description: Fairclinic Claims Aging: dental insurance claims still unpaid, aged by date sent, with follow-up dates, timely-filing risk, unsent and duplicate claims, and a payer follow-up letter for one named person to send. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-client-balances
plugins.description: Fairclinic Client Balances: veterinary client accounts receivable with the next step for each account: credits and unapplied deposits for a person to check, money over 90 days for collections review, no recent statement, and small balances. It never refunds, applies money or sends anyone to collections. Client names and account numbers are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-controlled-drugs
plugins.description: Fairclinic Controlled Drugs: reconciles a veterinary controlled drug log (DEA schedule items) with the physical count: the balance worked out from the entries against the written balance and the count, arithmetic errors that hide a difference, waste with no witness, use with no patient, entries with no initials. It reports the log; it never decides compliance or files anything. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-credential-expiry
plugins.description: Fairclinic Credential Expiry: dental and veterinary licences, DEA registrations, state permits, radiation registrations and malpractice insurance: expired, expiring with no renewal submitted, missing expiry dates, and CE hours short of what the next renewal needs. It never files a renewal or contacts a board, the DEA or an insurer.

plugins.name: fairclinic-era-posting
plugins.description: Fairclinic ERA Posting: reads dental ERAs (835 files or remittance exports) and compares each claim with what was posted in the practice system: payments not posted, posted amounts that differ, contractual write-offs that differ from the ERA, denials written off as contractual, reversals, postings that are not on the ERA, and check totals that do not tie. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-estimate-variance
plugins.description: Fairclinic Estimate Variance: veterinary treatment estimates against the final invoice: invoices well above the high estimate (check the client approved the increase), well below the low estimate (check nothing was left off), approved estimates never invoiced, and invoices raised on declined estimates. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-hygiene-production
plugins.description: Fairclinic Hygiene Production: dental hygiene production per worked hour for each hygienist, unfilled schedule time, the share of periodontal visits among cleanings, and production on days missing from the hours file. Not a pay calculation or a view on patient care.

plugins.name: fairclinic-inventory-expiry
plugins.description: Fairclinic Inventory Expiry: veterinary or dental stock by lot: expired stock still on hand, stock expiring soon and lots with no expiry date, valued at cost; and shrink or overage from opening, received, used and counted. It never disposes of, returns or writes off stock.

plugins.name: fairclinic-lab-cases
plugins.description: Fairclinic Lab Cases: the dental lab case log against seat appointments, billing and lab invoices: cases not back for the seat appointment, overdue from the lab, seated and not billed, remakes charged, duplicate invoices, invoices for cases not in the log or not back yet, and returned cases with no invoice. It never pays a lab or changes a case. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-membership-plans
plugins.description: Fairclinic Membership Plans: a month of in-house dental membership (savings) plan billing against the roster: missed and failed charges, wrong amounts, charges after cancelling, plan use after a membership ended, annual renewals due or lapsed, and charges for people not on the roster. It never charges, retries or refunds. Member names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-missed-charges
plugins.description: Fairclinic Missed Charges: what a veterinary treatment sheet or medical record says was done, against what was invoiced, matched by visit (or pet and date) and item: items not invoiced, quantities invoiced short, lines at no charge to confirm, and invoiced items missing from the record, valued from your price list. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-no-shows
plugins.description: Fairclinic No-shows: dental or veterinary appointments that were missed or cancelled late and not rebooked, repeat no-shows, no-show fees in your policy that were not charged (a person decides), no-show and late-cancellation rates by provider, and the scheduled value lost. It never books, messages or charges anyone. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-patient-balances
plugins.description: Fairclinic Patient Balances: dental patient and guarantor balances aged, with the next step for each account: credits for a person to check, missed payment-plan payments, money over 90 days for collections review, no recent statement, waiting on insurance, small balances; and a plain balance reminder for one named person to send. Names and account numbers are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-payroll-production
plugins.description: Fairclinic Payroll Production: dental or veterinary payroll hours and pay against collections per pay period: payroll as a percent of collections, collections per paid hour, periods over your target or missing a collections figure, high overtime by employee, and totals by role. Not a wage-and-hour review; it never changes pay or runs payroll.

plugins.name: fairclinic-pet-insurance-claims
plugins.description: Fairclinic Pet Insurance Claims: where each pet insurance claim stands: information requests from the insurer, direct payments that came in below the claim, claims drafted and not submitted, claims with no decision, and denials, with open amounts by insurer. It never submits a claim or charges a client. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-pharmacy-margins
plugins.description: Fairclinic Pharmacy Margins: veterinary in-house pharmacy prices against cost: items priced below cost, cost rises not passed on, margins under your target with the gap on quantities sold, and prescription items with no dispensing fee. It never changes a price.

plugins.name: fairclinic-ppo-fees
plugins.description: Fairclinic PPO Fees: your office fee schedule against each PPO's allowed amounts and what each PPO actually allowed: lines allowed below the plan's own fee, office fees below a plan fee, codes missing from a schedule or from your fees, and the write-off percent per code and plan. It never sets fees or touches a contract.

plugins.name: fairclinic-ppo-writeoffs
plugins.description: Fairclinic PPO Write-offs: dental adjustments and write-offs split into contractual (PPO) and discretionary, with write-off percent of production by carrier and discretionary adjustments by the person who entered them; flags duplicates, contractual write-offs for out-of-network carriers or no carrier, adjustments without a reason, and large ones. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-preauthorizations
plugins.description: Fairclinic Pre-authorizations: dental pre-authorizations and pre-treatment estimates that need a person: no answer from the carrier, approved but not scheduled, expiring or expired before the work is done, scheduled or done after the approval ran out, reduced or denied, or never sent. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-provider-production
plugins.description: Fairclinic Provider Production: dental production, adjustments and collections per provider and month: net production, collections as a percent of net, adjustments as a percent of gross, months well below a provider's others, and months missing from the export. Not a pay calculation or a judgment of anyone's clinical work.

plugins.name: fairclinic-recall-gaps
plugins.description: Fairclinic Recall Gaps: dental recall and hygiene patients who are overdue and not booked, missed a booked visit, are due soon, or have lapsed, with the last contact date; and how many hygiene visits leave with the next visit booked, per hygienist. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-reference-labs
plugins.description: Fairclinic Reference Labs: veterinary send-out tests on the reference lab's invoice matched to client charges for the same pet and date: tests not charged, charges below lab cost or under your markup rule, and send-out items charged with no test on the lab invoice. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-referral-tracking
plugins.description: Fairclinic Referral Tracking: referrals sent to specialists with no report back, referrals received that were never seen, referring doctors not thanked, and new patients and production by referral source. It reads dates and practice names only, never clinical details, and sends nothing. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-review-replies
plugins.description: Fairclinic Review Replies: online reviews that need a reply (low ratings first, and those that mention health or care details), reply drafts that thank or invite a call and never confirm the reviewer is a patient or client, and a check of any proposed reply for wording that would disclose a visit, care, records, a date or a name. One named person posts; the agent never does. Reviewer names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-staff-discounts
plugins.description: Fairclinic Staff Discounts: veterinary discounts and write-offs on invoices against your own policy: approved by the person who gave them or with no approver above your limit, staff discounts on accounts not on the staff list, discounts above your percent limit and discounts with no reason, with totals by the person who entered them. A flag is a question for a manager, not a finding about anyone. Client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-sterilization-logs
plugins.description: Fairclinic Sterilization Logs: gaps and open items in sterilizer cycle logs and spore test logs: entries without a result, number or initials, failed cycles with no rerun logged, missing cycle numbers, long gaps between spore tests while a sterilizer was in use, and positive spore tests with no retest logged. A log completeness check, never a compliance determination.

plugins.name: fairclinic-supply-costs
plugins.description: Fairclinic Supply Costs: dental or veterinary supplier invoices against production: supplies as a percent of production by month, unit prices up from the last price paid, the same line twice on an invoice, and categories far above their other months. It never pays a supplier or places an order.

plugins.name: fairclinic-unscheduled-treatment
plugins.description: Fairclinic Unscheduled Treatment: dental treatment that was accepted or proposed and never booked, per patient, with fees, insurance estimates and benefits left before the benefit year ends; old plans set aside for the dentist; a plain letter to one patient for one named person to send. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-vaccine-reminders
plugins.description: Fairclinic Vaccine Reminders: reads the veterinary practice system's reminder list for pets that are overdue and not booked, overdue with no recent reminder, due soon with no reminder, clients with no e-mail or phone, and reminders sent for pets marked deceased or inactive. Due dates come from your system; it never sets a schedule or sends a reminder. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.

plugins.name: fairclinic-wellness-plans
plugins.description: Fairclinic Wellness Plans: a month of veterinary wellness plan billing and plan use: failed, missed and wrong charges, services used beyond what the plan includes, and early cancellations where the services used are worth more than the fees paid. It never charges, retries or refunds. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.
